rita.devex: Quick note from today's onboarding lab: three different auth names surfaced across sample apps, CLI, and SDKs. New hires spent 10m debugging. Can we agree on a single canonical name and a short fallback policy?

chao.sdk: +1. proposal: canonical env var REDWOOD_API_KEY. SDKs should implement fallback for one release: REDWOOD_TOKEN and REDWOOD_KEY, but emit a single deprecation WARN at startup.

maria.security: Security requirements: do not log secrets in errors, avoid echoing env values, and prefer token-scoped claims when present. If token includes org/project claims, treat those as authoritative unless explicit constructor args provided.

rita.devex: UX thoughts: docs/sample apps should show container-friendly envs and a tiny precedence diagram. Also add a one-click local migration script that renames OLD -> REDWOOD_API_KEY (opt-in).

chao.sdk: SDK behavior summary I'll implement: 1) explicit constructor arg > 2) REDWOOD_API_KEY > 3) legacy aliases (log WARN) > 4) ~/.redwood/credentials > 5) metadata service. If multiple sources present and values differ, log WARN and prefer higher-precedence. Expose onAuthFailure(callback) and a configurable retryPolicy.

maria.security: Rotation policy: for short-lived creds, allow a refresh callback. On 401, SDKs should reload once and retry the request (max one immediate retry), then call onAuthFailure if still failing. Include jittered backoff when many clients are failing. Document expected behaviour.

ops-bot: scheduled: token-age audit next Tuesday. :calendar: Teams with keys > 60 days will receive reminders.

rita.devex: action items: chao opens PRs for node+python SDKs with deprecation warnings + onAuthFailure hook; I'll update sample apps and add migration helper; maria will add security checks for error messages. Reopen if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
